snippet.title: Half-Life: Savior Complex | TEASER TRAILER
snippet.description:
You play as a scientist that got himself lost in Xen during the resonance cascade incident and you have to find your way back and escape.
This is a short half life mod project that spans across 5 maps. It's short and simple and has been in development for 5 months now. I'm hoping for it to be released very soon.
Music used: Halo 3 OST: The farthest outpost
